reason: Complete mobile workload restarted in fresh contexts after the preceding attempt lost its worker during managed-environment recovery; partial samples are excluded.

conditions.history_edit_policy: Populated history has a current newest point; ordinary edit should not create another checkpoint inside its interval.
conditions.coverage: views, full-workspace batch, download/import and checkpoint recovery
conditions.reload_readiness_scope: Default active filter excludes the two completed recurrence ancestors; remaining phases explicitly select all tasks.
conditions.calendar_scope: Clock fixed to January 2039; transition includes visible month, exact dated preview count and bounded undated-card readiness, without month-navigation setup.

budgets.scope: Existing generous list load/search ceilings applied unchanged to this heavier controlled workload. Other operations are baseline-only.

limitations: CPU throttling and narrow viewports do not reproduce real mobile hardware.
Elapsed operation times include browser-driver/UI work; fixture setup and full-field signature verification are outside timings.
Heap and DOM samples are observations after operations, not peak memory, process RSS or a memory budget.
Fixture injection and integrity checks allocate JavaScript data outside measured intervals; their transient allocations may affect heap observations and collection.
Each repetition uses a fresh browser context; repeated operations within it are warm-cache observations.
Batch mode renders bounded pages; Select all matching acts on the complete match set including unloaded tasks.

limits: Resource limits and throttling are synthetic executor conditions, not measured physical device capabilities. The resumed and completed desktop runs occupy distinct controlled windows; no interrupted samples are merged.
